signal: IMPLAN launched its Forward Linkages suite with Price Change and tariff-impact insights in September 2025, expanding its economic-impact platform to over 1,000 cloud clients.

email.body1:
Paige, saw IMPLAN launched the Forward Linkages suite with tariff and price-change insights.

A timely new product like that usually surfaces more economists, agencies, and businesses in play than the team can reach, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for IMPLAN off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Paige, quick follow-up for IMPLAN.

With Forward Linkages widening the use cases, the regional pipeline target probably grew faster than the team can. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings IMPLAN needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Paige, last bit of proof for IMPLAN.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IMPLAN's reply rate likely compares to peer analytics and data teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
